settings.visualStyle: Grounded cinematic first-person WWII river-crossing realism during Operation Plunder, March 1945. British infantry POV, muddy Rhine bank, assault boats, cold dark water, smoke screens, flooded fields and German east-bank positions clearly separated. Non-graphic, sober and physically believable.
settings.customProjectStructure: 15 scenes x 8 seconds. No spoken dialogue, narrator or intelligible speech. Nearby friendlies remain British infantry. German defenders remain clearly separate across the river and inland. Use boat vibration, cold hands, water, smoke and post-crossing exhaustion with only short danger beats.
settings.customVisualStyle: Photorealistic first-person Rhine crossing reenactment with wet canvas, smoke haze, dark water, mud, boat movement, cold breath and cinematic shoreline reveals.

movie.storyTitle: WWII Soldier POV EP15 — Crossing the Rhine: Into Germany
movie.storySummary: A fictional British infantryman approaches the Rhine at night, boards an assault boat under smoke, crosses the cold river, reaches the east bank and moves into flooded fields before dawn.
movie.mainStoryPrompt: Make the river crossing itself the central physical experience: cold, mud, engine vibration, water, smoke and uncertainty. No dialogue or narration.

scenes.title: Mud to the River
scenes.actionDescription: He walks through deep mud toward the Rhine with rifle slung.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person British infantry sleeve, muddy boots, dark river glow ahead, friendlies in file.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow heavy walking. Audio: mud, gear, distant artillery, breath.

scenes.title: Smoke Screen
scenes.actionDescription: He reaches the bank as smoke drifts low across water.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person gloved hand on wet bank edge, smoke-covered Rhine, assault boats nearby.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow river reveal through smoke. Audio: water, engines, wind.

scenes.title: Boarding Boat
scenes.actionDescription: He steps down into a crowded British assault boat.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person boot entering boat, British uniforms and gear, dark water below.
scenes.videoPrompt: One careful step down and crouch. Audio: hull knock, water, gear.

scenes.title: Hands on Gunwale
scenes.actionDescription: He grips wet gunwale as boat accelerates.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person wet gloves on boat edge, dark river, smoke, weapon down between knees.
scenes.videoPrompt: Vibrating boat motion. Audio: engine, spray, breath.

scenes.title: Mid-River Darkness
scenes.actionDescription: He looks sideways into dark water and smoke with no visible shore for a moment.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person river surface, smoke haze, droplets on glove, British boat edge.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow side look and hold. Audio: engine, water, distant artillery.

scenes.title: Distant Impacts
scenes.actionDescription: Distant splashes appear well away and he ducks lower in boat.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person low boat interior, distant water splashes, no gore, friendlies crouched.
scenes.videoPrompt: Quick duck, boat continues. Audio: distant impacts, engine, breath.

scenes.title: East Bank Appears
scenes.actionDescription: Through smoke he sees the east-bank reeds and mud getting closer.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person prow toward dark east bank, reeds and smoke, British troops readying to disembark.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow bank reveal. Audio: engine lowering, water, breath.

scenes.title: Step Into Mud
scenes.actionDescription: He steps from boat into knee-deep mud and climbs bank.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person boots sinking in mud, hands grabbing reeds, rifle slung.
scenes.videoPrompt: Heavy step and climb. Audio: mud suction, water, gear.

scenes.title: Behind the Bank
scenes.actionDescription: He drops behind low bank and wipes water from gloves.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person wet gloves, muddy earth cover, friendlies nearby.
scenes.videoPrompt: Still recovery. Audio: breath, water, distant artillery.

scenes.title: Flooded Field
scenes.actionDescription: He walks carefully along flooded field edge behind squad.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person shallow water, reeds, British infantry ahead, separated opposing terrain farther inland.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow careful walk. Audio: splashes, wind, gear.

scenes.title: Farm Ditch
scenes.actionDescription: He lowers into a drainage ditch and rests rifle beside him.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person muddy ditch, wet sleeve, rifle resting, dim pre-dawn.
scenes.videoPrompt: Step down then still. Audio: water trickle, breath, distant guns.

scenes.title: Cold Fingers
scenes.actionDescription: He flexes cold wet fingers and tightens gloves.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person damp fingers and glove cuffs, muddy ditch wall.
scenes.videoPrompt: Quiet hand detail. Audio: fabric, water, breathing.

scenes.title: First Light East
scenes.actionDescription: He rises from ditch as gray dawn begins over fields.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person pale dawn over flooded German fields, British friendlies moving ahead.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow rise into dawn reveal. Audio: birds faint, wind, distant artillery.

scenes.title: Look Back at Rhine
scenes.actionDescription: He turns back and sees the river and boats through thinning smoke.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person Rhine behind, assault boats crossing, smoke lifting, wet sleeve foreground.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow turn to river scale reveal. Audio: wind, engines distant, breath.

scenes.title: Forward from the River
scenes.actionDescription: He turns forward and follows the British squad toward inland farm road.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person muddy boots, British soldiers ahead, gray morning fields, rifle slung.
scenes.videoPrompt: Steady forward walk. Audio: boots, gear, wind, tired breath. Fade.

characters.name: POV Soldier
characters.description: Anonymous British infantryman during Operation Plunder, March 1945.
characters.mainOutfit: British battledress, Mk III/Mk II helmet appropriate to unit, web gear, service rifle

continuity.continuityRules: Nearby friendlies remain British infantry. German defenders remain clearly separate. Preserve wetness, mud, cold hands and east-bank movement continuity.

atmosphereAssets.description: Mud, smoke screens and assault boats beside Rhine.

atmosphereAssets.title: Rhine Crossing
atmosphereAssets.description: Dark water, smoke, spray and British assault boat.

atmosphereAssets.title: East Bank Fields
atmosphereAssets.description: Mud, reeds, drainage ditches and flooded fields east of Rhine.
